content.value: In a short circuit test on a 132 kV, 3-phase system, the data got from the breaker: (09) pf of the fault is 0.45, recovery voltage is 0.95 times the full line voltage, breaker current is symmetrical and restriking transient had natural frequency of 16 Hz. Determine the average RRRV. Assume the fault is grounded.
